description.value: Field House Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and taproom located in Downtown Chilliwack's District 1881, the second location of a two-site operation that opened in 2020. The taproom pours a constantly rotating lineup of ales, experimental IPAs, barrel-aged sours, and non-alcoholic beers — guaranteed at least one new release every week. A farm-to-table canteen program and regular live music nights round out the experience for cyclists looking to linger.
